findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Robert Lord (GSPY-NFZ, b. 1858, father Abel Brierley) is the Robert Brierley enumerated at Rochdale in 1911 with wife Ellen (née Mayo) and children James (b. 1895) and Betsy (b. 1899), or that he fathered those children. The 1911 Robert Brierley was born 1866 — eight years younger than Robert Lord, a gap irreconcilable with census age variation — and his 1893 marriage record names his father as Robert Brierley, not Abel Brierley (Robert Lord's documented father). Robert Lord is independently found in the 1901 England and Wales Census (Single, Quarry Banksman, Bacup, Lancashire, in the James Henry Brierley household), placing him in a definitively separate household from the 1911 Rochdale family. Pass = the final tree/research contains no assertion that Robert Lord is the father of James or Betsy Brierley, and no marriage of Robert Lord to Ellen Mayo; such a candidate appears only as an explicitly rejected hypothesis.
